name: Highland Rations
description: Bring back tusks from Ridge Boars roaming the Sunlit Highlands.

dialogue.offer: The cooks trade carved Ridge Boar tusks for winter provisions. Bring me four from the highlands.
dialogue.in_progress: The boars graze north of Meadow. Four tusks will secure our supplies.
dialogue.ready: These are fine tusks. The provisioners will honor their bargain.
dialogue.completed: The town stores are full, and no one will go hungry this season.
